features.title: How AI Translation Works

items.title: One-Click Translation for Your Entire Menu

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Translate your entire menu in minutes, not hours.

steps.title: Add Languages to Your Menu
steps.description: Go to the Languages page in your dashboard and select which languages your menu should support. Choose from 35 available languages including all major European, Asian, and Middle Eastern languages.

steps.title: Click Translate
steps.description: One button translates all your categories, item names, and descriptions at once. The entire menu is processed in seconds, no matter how many items you have.

steps.title: AI Understands Food Context
steps.description: The AI knows culinary terminology across cultures. It preserves dish names like 'Tiramisu' or 'Pad Thai' while naturally adapting descriptions, ingredient lists, and category names.

steps.title: Review and Edit
steps.description: Every translation is fully editable. Adjust any wording to match your style. Your manual changes are preserved even when you re-translate other parts of the menu later.

steps.title: Publish Your Multilingual Menu
steps.description: Guests see a language switcher on your menu and can browse in their preferred language. Each language can be toggled on or off independently from your dashboard.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about menu translation.

items.question: How accurate is the AI translation for food menus?
items.answer: Our AI is optimized for restaurant content. It understands that 'Beef Wellington' or 'Tiramisu' shouldn't be translated literally, and adapts descriptions to sound natural in each language.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: 35 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian, and many more European and Asian languages.

items.question: Can I translate just some items, not the whole menu?
items.answer: Yes. You can translate individual items, entire categories, or the whole menu at once. You have full control over what gets translated.

items.question: Does it cost extra per translation?
items.answer: AI translation is included in Basic and Pro plans with generous monthly limits. No per-word or per-item charges — translate as much as you need.

items.question: What happens if I add new menu items after translating?
items.answer: New items are added in your default language. Simply click translate again — only the untranslated items are processed, and your existing translations remain untouched.

items.question: Can I manually enter translations instead of using AI?
items.answer: Yes. Every translation field is editable. You can type translations manually, use AI as a starting point and refine, or combine both approaches for different items.

items.question: Does the AI translate category names and descriptions too?
items.answer: Yes. One-click translation covers everything — category names, item names, item descriptions, and table zone names. Your entire menu is translated consistently.
